standard_prerequisites: Lemma lemma-injective-colimit-direct-sum-pushforwards-artin (delivered, L48106): every injective in QCoh(O_X) is a direct summand of a colimit of pushforwards from affine closed-ish subschemes over a Noetherian scheme... (the structure lemma used to decompose J)

Cohomology on Sites, Lemma sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray: Leray spectral sequence
core_obligations: Let X be a Noetherian algebraic space over S and J injective in QCoh(O_X). (1) H^p(U, J|_U) = 0 for p > 0 and every quasi-compact quasi-separated U etale over X. (2) For any f : X -> Y with Y quasi-separated, R^p f_* J = 0 for p > 0.
proof_roadmap: Part (1): decompose J as a direct summand of colim F_i with F_i = (Z_i -> X)_* G_i by the delivered structure lemma; vanishing passes to summands; colimits commute with H^p on qcqs U; each F_i|_U is R-times a pushforward along the affine Z_i x_X U -> U, which is acyclic since the source is affine; Leray concludes.

Part (2): for V affine etale over Y, the fibre V x_Y X is etale over X and quasi-compact quasi-separated (etale preserved by base change; morphisms from a Noetherian space are quasi-compact and quasi-separated - the author compresses this standard preservation check as 'details omitted'); part (1) kills H^p(V x_Y X, J); R^p f_* J is the sheafification of V |-> H^p(V x_Y X, J), so it is zero.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-part vanishing theorem whose argument is a complete Leray-type reduction; the single 'details omitted' covers a standard Noetherian qc/qs preservation check for the etale fibre, not a step of the claimed conclusion.
